plan.title: Optional project T&Cs do not block RFQ submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Set the project title required for publication.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the requested cylinder line item with quantity 10; location entry is not separately expressible by the catalog.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.

args.goal: on the RFQ create screen, open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clauses set to None, leave Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory unticked, click Done, and stop on the RFQ create screen

steps.note: Configure the two project-level clauses as optional.
Invite one QA vendor to receive and submit the RFQ.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round as the vendor.
Verify the first project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the second project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Submit a quote without accepting optional clauses.
Verify the vendor quote was accepted despite no mandatory clause acceptance.
Return to the buyer's project page.
Verify the buyer sees the vendor's submitted response.
